facts.media_arc_pattern: Every Page Art Direction Spine begins with hero_dominant_context + local_media_if_bound; remaining continuation beats are predominantly copy_evidence_only.

owner_bundle_baseline_contamination.finding: Within the Issue #124 ZIP, owner_html_bundle/cases/<case>/index.html and issue121_base/owner_html_bundle/cases/<case>/index.html are byte-identical for all 9 cases; the paired production_manifest.json files are also byte-identical.
owner_bundle_baseline_contamination.interpretation: The nested owner-HTML baseline is not an independent pre-Issue124 comparison artifact. This invalidates that packaged HTML pair as proof of before/after change. It does NOT by itself prove that the merged renderer was old; the packaged current HTML contains Issue #124 wp-* classes.
owner_bundle_baseline_contamination.required_recovery: Future Shun-facing evidence must cryptographically bind final renderer input HTML, screenshot output, owner HTML bundle, and an independently frozen rejected baseline.

perceptual_characterization.media_density: Sparse: only two image placements per page across five to seven sections. Asset existence therefore does not equal visible media presence.
perceptual_characterization.image_prominence: Some hero/body media can be large, but the page-level media rhythm stops after two placements and most continuation beats are copy/evidence-only.
perceptual_characterization.visual_storytelling: Media functions as isolated illustrative bindings rather than a sustained narrative sequence of world/context/process/detail/transition.
perceptual_characterization.section_silhouette: Issue #124 adds authored continuation families and longer body silhouettes versus Issue #121 screenshots, but the public visual grammar remains restrained and closely related.
perceptual_characterization.typography: The nine pages reuse the same two font-family variables and largely the same scale vocabulary; typography differentiates module structure more than brand/world authority.
perceptual_characterization.whitespace_density: Whitespace and density vary by continuation, but the dominant cadence remains calm bordered/inset information fields rather than benchmark-like shifts between immersive and informational scenes.
perceptual_characterization.background_material_variation: Dark/light and rule/inset changes exist, but material diversity remains narrow and often ledger/card/rail-like.
perceptual_characterization.editorial_composition: Structural asymmetry exists, yet image-led editorial sequencing is weak because only two media placements carry the entire page.
perceptual_characterization.interaction_motion: Six shared animation declarations exist per page; motion is light reveal/feedback and does not create major narrative transformation.
perceptual_characterization.screenshot_worthy_moments: Some continuation geometry is distinctive relative to sibling samples, but the pages lack enough high-impact authored focal scenes to escape the prior visual lineage at first glance.

conclusion: Issue #124 demonstrates structural divergence, not premium-perception recovery. Shun's 'ほとんど変わってない / 画像も入ってない' is consistent with both the sparse media facts and the retained public pixel grammar.
